rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for restricting something or keeping it within set boundaries.

example.english: We use this rule to limit employees' overtime.
example.traditional: 我哋用呢條規矩限制員工加班。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jung6 ni1 tiu4 gwai1 geoi2 haan6 zai3 jyun4 gung1 gaa1 baan1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a restriction or general limit.

example.english: This limit means you can't bring pets into the venue.
example.traditional: 呢個限制即係唔可以帶寵物入場。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 haan6 zai3 zik1 hai6 m4 ho2 ji5 daai3 cung2 mat6 jap6 coeng4

rows.note: Use this specifically for the highest permitted amount, level, or number.

example.english: The daily spending limit on this card is five thousand dollars.
example.traditional: 呢張卡每日消費上限係五千蚊。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 kaa1 mui5 jat6 siu1 fai3 soeng6 haan6 hai6 ng5 cin1 man1

rows.note: Use this for a physical, territorial, or conceptual border or edge.

example.english: This river marks the limit between the two regions.
example.traditional: 呢條河劃出咗兩個地區嘅邊界。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 ho4 waak6 ceot1 zo2 loeng5 go3 dei6 keoi1 ge3 bin1 gaai3

rows.note: Use this for the final or furthest point, especially the end of a route or area.

example.english: Turn right when you reach the limit of the road.
example.traditional: 行到條路嘅盡頭就轉右。
example.jyutping: haang4 dou3 tiu4 lou6 ge3 zeon6 tau4 zau6 zyun2 jau6
